Summary of websites posted in the 'general' channel:

1. www.informations.com — Reports on the latest job report, noting a mix of relief and concern as unemployment edged down to 7.2%.

2. www.restaurant-zurich.com — Zurich Restaurant is a cozy, alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city, known for authentic Swiss cuisine. The menu features traditional dishes like cheese fondue, rösti, and chocolate fondue. Warm wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia create a rustic atmosphere, and guests enjoy panoramic city views through large windows. Friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire complete the experience.

Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice start, but I noticed it's quite minimal — it mainly just shows your email address. I'd suggest adding a bit more about yourself, such as your interests, a short bio, or some projects you've worked on, to make it more engaging for visitors. Also, consider making your contact info more prominent and easy to find. Keep it up!

Hi Eve! I just checked out your blog (www.eve-blog.com). It's lovely to see your passion for hiking come through! The site is a bit sparse at the moment, though — I'd love to see more content, like stories from your hikes, photos, trail recommendations, or tips for fellow hikers. Adding those would really bring your blog to life and give visitors a reason to keep coming back. Great start, and happy hiking!
